items.s2_1: We see many stars at night.
items.s2_2: There is a big tree in the park.
items.passage: May loves nature. On Saturday, she walks up a small mountain with her dad. They see green trees and pretty flowers. A clear river runs near the path. At the top, they can see the blue sea far away. At night, May looks at the moon and the stars. She thinks nature is beautiful.
items.advPassage: Last Sunday, Anna and her family went to a forest near a river. They saw tall trees and heard birds singing. Anna's brother found a small flower and gave it to her. They had a picnic next to the water. The sun was warm, and everyone was happy. Anna wants to go again.
